items.title: Woody Marks: Back in Sunday's game
items.text:

items.title: Woody Marks: Departs Sunday's game
items.text:
Marks visited the sideline tent during Sunday's contest against the Giants due to an apparent left leg injury, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

items.title: Ollie Gordon: Stretches TD streak to four games
items.text:
Gordon rushed 25 times for 103 yards and a touchdown while catching one of three targets for no gain in Sunday's 28-25 win over the Jets.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Tops 100 rushing yards in Week 7
items.text:
Allen rushed 17 times for 104 yards and caught six of seven targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylin Noel: Dealing with toe injury
items.text:
Noel departed Sunday's game versus the Giants in the fourth quarter due to a toe injury.
